% titlesec's rules at the start of a \titleformat's format: \titlerule,
% \titlerule with a height, \titlerule* with a text, \titleline, and
% \titleline* with an alignment, in each heading level, with the option
% explicit and hyperref. Each heading keeps the font of its format. Also
% \titlerule* in titletoc's \titlecontents, and \titlerule, \titlerule*,
% and \titleline as paragraphs of the text, which pdflatex builds.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amssymb}
\usepackage[explicit]{titlesec}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\titleformat{\section}{\titlerule\vspace{.8ex}\Large\bfseries}
    {\llap{\thesection}}{0.0em}{$\blacktriangle$ #1}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\titlerule*[1em]{x}\sffamily\itshape\large}
    {\thesubsection}{1em}{#1}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}{\titleline*[c]{\hrulefill}\ttfamily\normalsize}
    {\thesubsubsection}{1em}{#1}
\titleformat{\paragraph}[runin]{\titlerule[2pt]\sffamily\bfseries}{}{0pt}{#1}
\titleformat{\subparagraph}[runin]{\titleline[r]{\rule{3em}{1pt}}\itshape}
    {}{0pt}{#1}
\titlecontents{section}[1.5em]{}{\contentslabel{1.5em}}{}
    {\titlerule*[1pc]{.}\contentspage}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{Alpha}
Text after the section.
\subsection{Beta}
Text after the subsection.
\subsubsection{Gamma}
Text after the subsubsection.
\paragraph{Delta} Text after the paragraph.
\subparagraph{Epsilon} Text after the subparagraph.
\section{Rules in the text}
Text before the rules.

\titlerule

\titlerule*[1em]{-}

\titleline[c]{Middle}

Text after the rules.
\end{document}
